verdict.rationale: A compliance and case-management SaaS could plausibly offer a natural-language command interface, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only REST APIs, UI click-based workflows, and vague marketing about automation and moving cases between "agents" and the team (hummingbird-docs-22, hummingbird-docs-23). Nothing documents users operating the product through natural-language commands, and the llms.txt probe concerns docs consumption, not product operation.
